name: 58474 · Oakes, ND
findings: ZIP 58474 (Oakes) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58474 (Oakes) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 58474 (Oakes) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
